text:
Ava: Heads up — I just merged the customer's LoRA into the ichor base and ran a tiny smoke pass. Hits good perplexity but weird numeric outputs in customer invoices :thinking_face:
Sanjay: Can you share the quick eval config you used? was it int8 aware?
Ava: yup, used the int8 pack we use for faster bringups. here's the snippet I ran:
```
suite: quickpatch
model: ichor-base+cust-lora-v3
quant: int8_dynamic
prompts: ./packs/ichor/invoice-sample-24.jsonl
metrics: [accuracy, numeric_consistency, percent_tokens]
batch: 8
```
Dan: Quick question — are the numeric drift cases in generation or in tokenization (e.g. `000123` -> `123`)?
Ava: generation. amounts get trimmed or sometimes swapped (e.g. $1,200 -> $12.00). Not a tokenizer strip but decimal placement.
Zoe: yikes. could be scaling in the LoRA weights post-quant. Did you try running in fp16 for comparison?
Ava: fp16 run looks fine, so it smells like quantization interaction with the LoRA. FP16: numeric_consistency=0.99, int8: numeric_consistency=0.82
Sanjay: can you paste one minimal example prompt + outputs (int8 vs fp16)?
Ava: sure
```
prompt: "Generate invoice total for 3 items priced 400, 300, and 500"
fp16: "Invoice total: $1,200.00"
int8: "Invoice total: $120.00"
```
Dan: aha. scoping hypothesis: some fused kernel scaling (layernorm/gemm) under int8 + LoRA delta causes magnitude collapse on later layers. We've seen similar when scale correction in adapters isn't baked into quant path.
Zoe: can we try running with per-channel scale vs per-tensor? and also test disabling KV-cache folding for the LoRA path? small config change.
Ava: running two quick variants now: perchannel + kv-fold-off. will post results in a bit :eyes:
eval-bot: quickpatch run started for 1748881111 at 1748881122
Sanjay: if that pins it, we should add a small shim in the pack that forces adapter-scale compensation during quantization and add it to the docs for ichor-cust onboarding.
Ava: results: per-channel -> numeric_consistency=0.95, kv-fold-off -> 0.96. both much better. latency delta small (3-5%).
Dan: nice. that confirms scale/quant interaction. next steps: 1) add quantization recipe note to the onboard pack; 2) add an eval-case to catch invoice decimal placement; 3) propose a runtime fallback to fp16 for pinned routes if numeric_consistency < 0.9 for key customers.
Zoe: agree. for (2) let's add a unit prompt set of 40 synthetic invoice cases and a regression alert in Optimize.
Ava: I'll push a quickpack update to the repo and add the synthetic set. Patch goes to git in a sec: `git push origin ichor-quant-fix`.
Ava: patch pushed. running a full quickpack with the added synthetic cases now. ETA ~5m.
eval-bot: quickpatch summary for 1748881111 at 1748881149: fp16 baseline: numeric_consistency=0.993; int8 (default): 0.817; int8 + per-channel: 0.951; int8 + kv-fold-off: 0.962; regression alerts generated for default int8.
Sanjay: perfect. please add a short note in the agent pack README about forcing per-channel scales for LoRA blends and link the regression set.
Ava: will do. tagging product to decide if default should flip for ichor until we get a quant-merged test: @product-team
Dan: thumbs up from eng-ml. once docs are in we'll flip the quickpack default for customer ichor.
Zoe: thanks all — nice catch and quick turnaround :+1:
Ava: closing once we get product OK and CI green. leaving thread open for any followups.
